iOS

Android
Open in Chrome → Tap "Install App" or the three dots → "Add to Home screen".

  • ✨ 100% Offline Capability with Service Worker
  • 🧭 Real-time iOS & Android Compass Hardware Sensors

  • 🔴 Tactical Night Vision (Red Mode) & Stargazer Guide
  • 🆘 Emergency SOS Morse Code Flasher (Screen + Torch)
  • 🧲 Live EMF Magnetic Flux Density & Metal Anomaly Alert
  • 🕒 Virtual Sundial Shadow & Local Apparent Solar Time
  • ☀️ Solar Ephemeris: Real-time Sun Azimuth, Elevation & Golden Hour

  • 📍 Offline Waypoint Navigator ("Find My Car / Camp / Spot")
  • 🔊 Synthetic Audio Chimes & Spoken Heading Announcements
  • 🎯 Advanced Sensor Calibration & Manual Alignment Studio
  • ⚖️ Dual-axis Pitch & Roll Inclinometer Bubble Level
  • 🎯 Target Heading / Bearing Deviation Lock
  • 📍 GPS Coordinates (Decimal + DMS), Altitude & Accuracy
  • 📳 Haptic Vibration feedback on Cardinal headings
  • 🎨 4 Visual Themes: Tactical OLED, Apple Glass, Marine Brass, Red Night
